phase: Accounting-constrained empirical dynamics / F3 observed behavior diagnostics
purpose: Derive descriptive behavior-over-time diagnostics from the retained F3 quarterly empirical replay without promoting the incomplete multi-instrument sectoral-financial-positions reference mode or assigning causal meaning.
observed_outputs: quarterly sector F3 assets, liabilities and net F3 positions
quarterly sector transaction and combined non-transaction decomposition for Q2-Q4
exact descriptive pattern labels based only on retained quarterly observations

descriptive_pattern_rules.FLAT: All three quarter-to-quarter changes equal zero at retained published precision.
descriptive_pattern_rules.MONOTONIC_INCREASE: All three quarter-to-quarter changes are strictly positive.
descriptive_pattern_rules.MONOTONIC_DECREASE: All three quarter-to-quarter changes are strictly negative.
descriptive_pattern_rules.MIXED: The observed quarterly path satisfies none of the exact flat/monotonic rules.

decomposition_rule.reason: Q1 is the retained opening state for the first replayable transition; Q1 transaction cannot be included in this decomposition because 2024-Q4 opening stock is outside the retained source vintage.
decomposition_rule.combined_nontransaction_semantics: The exact accounting residual retained by the F3 replay: revaluations plus other changes in volume combined. No component decomposition or causal attribution is allowed.

methodological_context.system_dynamics_reference_mode_rule: Observed behavior over time may inform later problem articulation and behavior-reproduction testing but is not itself a feedback mechanism or proof of causal structure.
methodological_context.accounting_rule: Financial positions change through transactions and other flows; other flows include revaluations and other changes in volume.
